item.title: Petrolhead or not, you can’t help but love Bike Forge
item.description: An unexpected pitstop in Tulbagh with a classic bike museum, restaurant serving gastro pub food, pit braais, and even glamping An unexpected pitstop in Tulbagh with a classic bike museum, restaurant serving gastro pub food, pit braais, and even glampin

item.title: Leisure-led living in Somerset West’s iconic estate: Launches March 2026
item.description: Close to top schools, wine estates, golf courses and most-loved shopping destinations. The Charles offers luxe living in a gated community from R2.1m

item.title: UPDATED: 25+ new restaurants and experiences in Cape Town 2026
item.description: Ouzeri’s cocktail and natural wine bar, all-pink cottage café and bakery in Claremont, free family-friendly market and more new places to try.

item.title: 25 of Cape Town’s most popular, unique & unusual clubs and bars
item.description: Afro house, gqom, amapiano, Afrikaans, disco, indie, house, techno emo, and even K-pop. These clubs & bars host top DJs & offer great food & drinks specials

item.title: Handcuffs, Fanta foam cocktails, fire dancers – just another night at fable
item.description: The top cocktail bar known for elaborate & crazily-inventive cocktails. What we love most is that fable is accessible with daily happy hour & tiered prices

item.title: Mavericks Revue Bar: Food, drinks & performances till 4am
item.description: Find the best late-night food in Cape Town at Mavericks. Enjoy full-menu dining till 4am, premium drinks, DJs, dancers and a vibrant atmosphere till 4am

item.title: 15+ ways to spend the school holidays, for kids and adults
item.description: Ideas for every age group, from themed holiday programmes, to a fossil park, new “park” on Sea Point Promenade & more.

item.title: Things to do on Human Rights Day 2026
item.description: While we don’t have the day off this year, there’s still plenty of ways to spend it. Free guided tours at a historical exhibition, family festival under R50, and more

item.title: Where to hunt for Easter eggs in Cape Town 2026
item.description: Some hunts are just R50 and R20! All kinds, like hunts through a bird sanctuary, heritage exhibition, forest and more

item.title: Our team’s top picks for how to spend this weekend
